quest.title: A Teapot to Call Home: Part II
quest.description: The crisis looming over Liyue Harbor has calmed, and it's business as usual in the city. However, Madame Ping, the flower-admirer from Yujing Terrace, seems to have something more to discuss with you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... this teapot seems even bigger inside than Madame Ping's. There's even a great big house in the middle, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, but there's just a whole load of nothing around it...

choices.text: Get chiseling, Paimon — you could carve us a whole house out of this rock.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can't do that! Well, you're the one with a sword, anyway — you do it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still... why is it so empty here apart from that house?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, wait a second, what is that?

choices.text: Go dig a burrow to live in for now, I guess?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! There's a perfectly good house right over there. Why should Paimon have to live in a hole in the ground!?

dialogues.text: Well! It seems that we have a visitor...

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Well! It seems that we have a visitor... Oh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, it's Tubby! From a distance, Paimon thought it was just a huge finch!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're the "little helper" Madame Ping mentioned?

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Madame Ping... Oh, you must mean Ping! Yes, she did summon me here. She told me much about you.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: You know, back when we met in the Mondstadt tavern, I had a feeling that we would meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: It seems I was right. But it's still a nice surprise to meet you here.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: You may leave all matters regarding the upkeep of this realm to me.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Your journey may be far from over... but at least this way, you will not want for a comfortable place to sleep each night.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what's a teapot spirit, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Though it is the adepti who create realms such as this, they generally do not have the time of day to attend to the banal matter of their maintenance.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Thus, we teapot spirits were created to help guard their realms and manage their affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: You may consider me a butler, if you will.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Now, allow me to explain this realm to you...

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Have you any blueprints on you? Specifically, blueprints with beautiful rooms, chairs, and the like.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: As long as you have a blueprint, you can refashion this realm however you please.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Blueprints? Oh, that's right! Granny handed us some when she gave us the teapot, didn't she? Let's take them out and have a look!

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Yes, these are the blueprints I'm talking about. Go on, open them up...

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Just commit the image of the objects to memory and prepare the necessary materials...

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Then, simply release the thought from your mind and the object in the blueprint shall appear within this teapot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, is that all it takes? Then... we could build a whole city inside, couldn't we!

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Hmm... I doubt it. A golden-eyed adeptus explained this to me at some point in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: He said that even though Sub-Space Creation is a product of adeptal power, even that has its limits.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: This world is not a true one, after all. It provides merely a moment of brief respite from the mortal realm, not a means of escaping it entirely.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A golden-eyed adeptus? Paimon wonders — who could that be...

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: I hardly remember myself. What's more, I have never seen that adeptus again since...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How very strange...

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: Well, let's not dwell on that. Have a look around — best you get accustomed to this realm.

dialogues.speaker: Tubby
dialogues.text: If there's anything you would like to ask, just look for me.
